answer: Give every identity the same degraded signal each epoch: a half-erased survey of a reef guarding a harbor, half its soundings smudged, and require each to reconstruct the chart independently. One operator's sybil fleet shares one model and pipeline, so its fakes err in the same places; genuine strangers reconstruct differently while agreeing on the clear features. Admit only charts accurate on legible soundings yet decorrelated in their mistakes, cross-checked against a mirror survey from a second vantage. Many fakes then means many truly different minds — the cost sybils exist to avoid.
